# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- Use a modern UI style with dark blue and light beige/off-white as primary brand colors, plus supporting blue and neutral gray variations instead of a flat two-color palette.
- Design this internal app mobile-first, using a lighter beige background.
- Keep sidebar links highly visible on dark blue backgrounds.
- Avoid a separate 'Bientôt' section and unnecessary hero sections on internal pages.
- Keep better spacing between buttons and surrounding elements.
- Align module icons and labels on the same line.
- Include a footer with 'FedNad Holding © 2026'.
- Ensure every new UI element follows the app's shared general CSS styling and design tokens across the entire app: buttons, inputs, grids, tables, divs, sections, cards, panels, messages, spacing, and layout structures—not just selected controls.

## Edit Flows
- For correction/edit flows in this app, avoid a separate 'Corriger' button when possible; list items should be clickable to enter edit mode, and the same interaction pattern should be used consistently across modules.
